translations.web: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.
translations.bsb: The death He died, He died to sin once for all; but the life He lives, He lives to God.
translations.kjv: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
translations.asv: For the death that he died, he died unto sin once: but the life that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
